Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Conroe, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1 reported
turning left and was struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding straight. The impact landed on the driver's side
of Driver 1's vehicle, and the damage visible on both vehicles is consistent with a broadside collision of this type. No
prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to me or reported by anyone at the scene. Driver 1 stated that a
shoulder injury was sustained in the impact, and the nature of that injury fits the force and direction of the collision as
observed. A passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the passenger's presence and Driver 1's
presence were confirmed by statements from witnesses at the scene. Driver 2 gave an account of the collision that
matches Driver 1's description. Several witnesses and photographs taken at the scene corroborate the sequence of
events as reported. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
